At GEO, we believe that a variety of views and perspectives are integral parts of our company's success. This unique mixture in the workforce provides unlimited ideas, increases productivity and innovative solutions for our clients and those we serve.

GEO Reentry provides individuals that have transitioned from incarceration to the community with temporary housing, cognitive behavioral treatment, substance abuse treatment, and employment and education readiness programs.
The GEO Group Foundation is dedicated to supporting charitable and educational causes throughout the United States.
The GEO Continuum of Care
The GEO Continuum of Care is enhanced rehabilitation and reentry programming, including cognitive behavioral treatment, integrated with post–release support services.
GEO strives to ensure that healthcare staff, including medical, nursing, dental, and mental health professionals, are available to provide care for everyone in our facilities.

GEO Care applies the human-centered approach to provide participant resource connections for individuals released to the community. For more than 25 years, we have provided community-based, trauma-informed, and culturally sensitive case management services tailored to the unique needs of the individuals and families we serve.

raw_blocks: GEO provides complementary, turnkey solutions for numerous government partners worldwide across a spectrum of diversified correctional and community reentry services. From the development of state-of-the-art facilities and the provision of management services and evidence-based rehabilitation to the post-release reintegration and supervision of individuals in the community, GEO offers fully diversified, cost-effective services that deliver enhanced quality and improved outcomes.
Global Leader in Evidence-Based Rehabilitation

The GEO Group is committed to providing leading, evidence-based rehabilitation programs to individuals while in-custody and post-release into the community through the GEO Continuum of Care®. GEO's diversified services platform provides unique capabilities for the delivery of educational and vocational programs, cognitive behavioral and substance abuse treatment, and faith-based services. The GEO Continuum of Care is enhanced in-custody offender rehabilitation programming, including cognitive behavioral treatment, integrated with post–release support services.
GEO aspires to be the world's leading provider of evidence-based rehabilitation across a diversified spectrum of correctional and community reentry services.

GEO's mission is to develop innovative public-private partnerships with government agencies around the globe that deliver high quality secure facility, community reentry, and electronic monitoring services while providing industry leading rehabilitation and community reintegration programs to the men and women entrusted to our care.
We believe that every human being should be treated with dignity and that his or her basic human rights should be respected and preserved at all times.
We are committed to providing leading, evidence-based rehabilitation programs to the men and women entrusted to our care.
We are committed to establishing and maintaining a workplace that is safe, secure and humane, not only for our trained and experienced professionals, but for the men and women entrusted to our care.
We are committed to maintaining facilities that are state-of-the-art and adhere to industry-leading standards.
